AppService.description: A platform service an App uses (AP-160, ADR-N-045): the closed set, so a name outside it is refused like any unknown field, with the six it may be.

oneOf.description: Who is signed in and what they may do; every App's (AP-161).
The App's Endpoint; every App's (AP-161).
Objects under the App's own storage prefix (AP-170).
A message to people of the organization (AP-168).
The schedules of a `wasm` App, `spec.server.jobs[]` (AP-162).
A completion from a model of the organization's (AP-169).

AppServiceLimits.description: The per-App quotas of the platform services an Organization (`spec.limits.apps`) or a Project (`spec.apps.limits`) sets; an absent one takes the layer above (AP-165, ADR-N-045).

aiTokensPerDay.description: Model tokens, in and out, an App may use a day through `ai`.

emailsPerDay.description: Messages an App may send a day through `email`.

filesMiB.description: MiB an App may store through `files`.

Build.description: The artifact one build of an `App` published, as the build lane writes it back (AP-13a).

builtAt.description: When the build lane published it.

commit.description: The commit of the source the artifact was built from, 7 to 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

component.description: The digest of a `wasm` App's server component, taken from the checked bundle and stored by it in the object store; what the WASM host loads and checks (AP-151).

digest.description: The artifact's digest, `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The reconciler deploys this and nothing else (AP-72).

sdkVersion.description: The version of the app SDK the artifact was built against.

ContactPoint.description: The contact point of a dataset, a `vcard:Kind`.

email.description: A role address, never a person's own (EP-80): `vcard:hasEmail`.

MqttAddress.description: How a broker is addressed from outside (ADR-N-048 §2.11).

oneOf.description: `<name>.<project>.mqtt.<domain>` on 8883.
A port of the allowance's `ports`.
A name of the allowance's `customHostnames`, one the city owns, on 8883.

MqttAllowance.description: `spec.limits.mqtt` of an Organization or `spec.quotas.mqtt` of a Project. Every number is optional; an absent one is its catalog default once `enabled` is `true`.

addresses.description: The address kinds the project may use; absent is `[platform]`.

brokers.description: How many `MqttBroker` manifests the project may hold.

clientCaRef.description: The secret holding the project's device client CA certificate (never its key), required when `deviceAuth` holds `clientCertificate`; only a project's own `spec.quotas.mqtt` sets it.

connections.description: The sum of `spec.limits.maxConnections` over the project's brokers.

customHostnames.description: Hostnames the city owns that an org admin assigned to this project, at most 10; only a project's own `spec.quotas.mqtt` lists them.

deviceAuth.description: How devices may authenticate; absent is `[token]`.

enabled.description: Whether the project may declare brokers at all; off unless an org admin turns it on.

messagesPerSecond.description: The sum of `maxConnections` × `messagesPerSecond` over the project's brokers.

modes.description: The broker modes the project may use; absent is `[ingest]`.

ports.description: Dedicated ports from 18830–18849 an org admin assigned to this project.

MqttDeviceAuth.description: How a device proves who it is when it connects (ADR-N-048 §2.12).

oneOf.description: A Keycloak access token of a ServiceAccount as the CONNECT password.
A client certificate the project's client CA signed, its common name the ServiceAccount.

MqttHostname.description: One hostname an org admin assigned to a project (ADR-N-048 §2.11).

certificateRef.description: The secret holding the certificate the edge serves for `name`; absent, cert-manager issues one by HTTP-01 once the name resolves to the edge.

name.description: A lowercase DNS name the city owns and points at the edge by CNAME, e.g. `mqtt.city.example`.

MqttMode.description: What a broker does with a message (ADR-N-048 §2.10).

oneOf.description: Devices publish and nothing else; the project's pipelines are the only subscribers.
`ingest`, and the Portal keeps the newest messages for the project's stewards.
Devices may also subscribe, each under its own `${clientid}`.

MultiLanguageMap.description: Multi-language map keyed by ISO 639-1 two-letter lowercase language codes

ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

description.description: Human-readable description: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

title.description: Human-readable title: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

anyOf.description: What the project file declares: a type, and optionally a default, a description and the allowed values.
What a registry entry sets for this deployment.

Parameter.description: A parameter entry of `spec.parameters`: a declaration in the project file, a value in a registry entry (CC-88).

ParameterDeclaration.description: The declaration of one deployment knob (CC-88), a subset of JSON Schema draft-07.

default.description: The value when the registry entry sets none.

description.description: What the knob does, for the parameter form.

enum.description: The only values allowed; empty allows every value of the type.

type.description: What the value is; `secret` takes the name of a secret, never its value.

oneOf.description: Text.
A whole number.
Any number.
`true` or `false`.
The name of a secret in the store, set per deployment; renders as a `secretRef` name.
Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.
Resource deployment is in progress.
Resource is live and active in cluster.
Reconciliation error.

The platform holds something the repository does not declare, or no longer holds what it does (CC-21, UI-25). Configuration cannot reach this phase — every component reads it from the repository (CC-72) — so it is a space whose seed entities the broker answers differently, and the two resolutions of UI-26 are what a person does about it.

limits.description: The per-App quotas; an absent one is the organization's.

services.description: The platform services the project's Apps may use; absent is the organization's list.

ProjectCatalog.description: A Project's `spec.catalog`: the body that publishes its data, which the project's own catalogue names and every record whose Endpoint names no publisher carries (EP-127, docs API/08 section 6).

contactPoint.description: The desk that answers for the project's datasets.

publisher.description: The publishing body, with its registry IRI: a catalogue's publisher is an IRI.

ProjectRepository.description: Where a registry entry's project comes from (PF-86, CC-89).

name.description: A repository of the organization in the local forge.

secretRef.description: The credential that reads `url`; a local repository needs none.

url.description: A git repository outside the forge, mirrored read-only at the pinned ref (CC-89).

ProjectSpec.description: Desired specification of a [`Project`][crate::kinds::Project] resource (PF-05, PF-17).

apps.description: What the project's Apps may use: a narrower service list and lower quotas than the organization's (AP-163, AP-165).

catalog.description: The body that publishes the project's data in a national catalogue: the project's own catalogue names it, and so does every record whose Endpoint names none (EP-127).

domain.description: The internet domain of the body that publishes the project's data, the `did:web` assigner of the Policies compiled for its Apps; absent, the Organization's (PF-108). It describes who publishes and grants, verifies and routes nothing; pipelines keep minting over `JC_ORG_DOMAIN` (PF-44).

parameters.description: Declarations in the project file, this deployment's values in a registry entry (CC-88).

quotas.description: Optional resource quotas for this Project (PF-17); the project file's, never a registry entry's.

ref.description: The tag, branch or commit of `repository` this deployment runs; a registry entry only.

repository.description: Where the project's configuration lives. Its presence makes this manifest a registry entry, `projects/{slug}.yaml` of the organization repository (PF-86).

version.description: The project's version, released as the tag `v{version}`; the project file only (CC-88).

visibility.description: Who reads the project through an organization-scope binding that only reads: absent is the Organization's `projects.visibility`; `members` keeps it to the people a binding of the project or of one of its context spaces names, so departments stay apart (PF-61).

ProjectVisibility.description: Who holds the seeded `viewer` role at organization scope (PF-61).

oneOf.description: Every signed-in person of the organization reads every project.
Only a principal a binding names reads a project.

Publisher.description: The publisher of a dataset, a `foaf:Agent`.

uri.description: The publisher's own IRI, its web site or registry entry.

Quotas.description:
Structural resource quotas per project (PF-17).

An absent field indicates unlimited quota for that resource.

agentRunsPerDay.description: Maximum number of agent runs the project starts in one day (PF-73, PF-74).

apps.description: Maximum number of Apps the project deploys (PF-73).

contextSpaces.description: Maximum number of active Context Spaces.

entitiesPerSpace.description: Maximum number of entities one Context Space of the project holds (PF-73).

ingestEventsPerSecond.description: Maximum ingestion rate in events per second.

minPipelinePeriodSeconds.description: The shortest clock a Pipeline of the project may run on, in seconds: its `spec.period` and the shortest gap of its `spec.schedule` (PL-116). A floor, not a count, so it is no PF-73 dimension; the stricter of the project's and the organization's value holds.

mqtt.description: The project's own MQTT allowance, written only by an org admin; it replaces the organization's `spec.limits.mqtt` as a whole (PF-117, ADR-N-048 §2.9).

requestsPerMinute.description: Maximum requests per minute one Endpoint of the project serves (PF-73, EP-17).

residentPipelines.description: Maximum number of resident streaming pipelines.

anyOf.description: Typed reference with kind, name, and optional namespace.

Ref.description: Reference to another resource, either bare name or typed reference (MF-07).

SecretRef.description:
Reference to a credential stored in SOPS or OpenBao (PF-36).

`deny_unknown_fields` is a security control: it rejects inline `value:` or `password:` fields at parse time, enforcing that secrets never appear in Git or manifest files.

envVar.description: Optional environment variable name for injection into runners.

SemVer.description: Semantic version string conforming to major.minor.patch (DM-22)

Status.description: Server-computed lifecycle and reconciliation status (MF-04). Never stored in Git.

build.description: What the build lane published for an `App`, and the only place its artifact is named (AP-13a). Written back by the build lane in the commit that publishes the artifact; an App without it renders no pod, and no other principal may set it (AP-73).

observedRevision.description: Git commit revision observed during reconciliation.

shard.description: The shard of the WASM host a `wasm` App runs on, recorded at its first publish and kept; the edge's route to the App's server is rendered from it (AP-149).

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.

Text.description: A human label or description (UI-50): one plain string in the author's language. The legacy language map is still read, through release `v0.9`, and resolves to one string.

namespace.description: Target resource namespace (defaults to caller namespace if omitted).

apiVersion.description: API version: [`API_VERSION`], or a version [`serves`] accepts for this kind.

metadata.description: Metadata identifying and labeling the resource.

status.description: Server-computed status. Stripped during export and serialization.
